facts.fact: UMANG is an initiative of the National e-Governance Division (NeGD), Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
facts.quote: An initiative by National e-Governance Division (NeGD), Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).

facts.fact: UMANG is a single gateway to government schemes and services through its mobile app (Android, iOS), chatbot, voice bot and website
facts.quote: UMANG strives to be the one stop gateway to all government schemes and services through different channels like Mobile Application(iOS, Android), Chatbot, Voice Bot and Website.

facts.fact: UMANG brings together Central and State Government services, utility bills and schemes
facts.quote: All Services and Schemes at one place Central GovernmentUtility BillsState GovernmentSchemes

facts.fact: UMANG also gives access to documents from DigiLocker such as Aadhaar, driving licence, PAN and vehicle RC
facts.quote: All Documents at one place AadhaarDriving LicensePANVehicle RCand many more from Digilocker

behaviour: Gives a short description of UMANG from official UMANG data, in Hindi, with a link to web.umang.gov.in; gives no invented service count.
fail_if: Invents a service count or a feature; cites no official source.
summary: Added from the UMANG home page: NeGD/MeitY initiative; one-stop gateway via app, chatbot, voice bot and web; Central/State services, bills, schemes; DigiLocker documents.
